Overview.Name: Balagouni Rambabu Goud
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (apple, orange, papaya or guava)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (75 g) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (75 g) + curd (small bowl)

Notes_and_Tips: Eat meals at regular times even if work hours are irregular.
Include eggs, paneer or soya chunks every day to support protein intake.
When sweet cravings occur, eat a fruit first and wait 10 minutes before deciding on dessert.
Practice yoga consistently to help improve stress levels and thyroid health.
Stay hydrated by drinking 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
Aim for 7–8 hours of quality sleep whenever possible.
